Which Dhaka areas does DSCA serve?

DSCA's barista courses run at House 34/A, Indira Road, Farmgate, Dhaka-1215. Farmgate has its own MRT Line 6 station, and four other areas on this page, Karwan Bazar, Shahbag, Agargaon and Bijoy Sarani, are one or two stops away. Dhanmondi, Green Road, Rajabazar, Tejgaon and Hatirjheel are reached by rickshaw, CNG or ride-share.
Pick the neighbourhood closest to your home, office or university. Each page gives the route from that area, local landmarks and answers to local questions.

DSCA trains on commercial espresso machines in small batches of up to 12 students. Courses cover espresso making, milk texturing, latte art and café workflow, and students receive certification and guidance for career growth. The five courses run from the 2-day Food Safety Management course to the 22-day Barista Advance Professional.
Reaching the Farmgate campus by metro or by road

MRT Line 6 stops at Agargaon, Bijoy Sarani, Farmgate, Karwan Bazar and Shahbag, in that order. Get off at Farmgate Station and follow Indira Road to Kazi & Chitra Square. Bijoy Sarani and Karwan Bazar are one stop from Farmgate. Agargaon and Shahbag are two. The Daily Ittefaq reported on 30 June 2026 that the line carries an average of about 410,000 passengers a day.

Dhanmondi, Green Road, Rajabazar, Tejgaon and Hatirjheel have no Line 6 station of their own. Students from these areas usually travel by rickshaw, CNG or ride-share. Farmgate is one of the busiest junctions in Dhaka, so leave extra time at peak hours.

The Daily Star's Business Plus section reported on 10 May 2025 that Bangladesh's coffee imports rose from 264 tonnes in 2012 to 1,745 tonnes in 2022, and that coffee is consumed in about 15% of households, against over 90% for tea. The same report says cafés began to boom in Dhaka around 2012 and now cluster in areas such as Dhanmondi, Banani, Uttara and Mirpur. A trained barista is part of that growth.

The Barista Intermediate course is the shortest barista option at 3 days and ৳4,950. Barista Professional runs 10 days, the DSCA Barista Starter Pack runs 15 days and Barista Advance Professional runs 22 days. Food Safety Management is a separate 2-day course. Open the course page for the full syllabus, or call the team to match a course to your goal.

Dhaka Specialty Coffee Academy is at House 34/A, Indira Road, Farmgate, Dhaka-1215, inside Kazi & Chitra Square (Lift 5), next to Kutubbag Darbar Sharif. It is open Saturday to Friday, 9:00 am to 9:00 pm.

Farmgate and Indira Road are the campus streets. Karwan Bazar, Rajabazar, Bijoy Sarani and Green Road are within about 2 km. Tejgaon, Shahbag, Agargaon and Hatirjheel are roughly 2 to 3 km away, and Dhanmondi is about 3 to 4 km away.

Hatirjheel is a lakefront of 122 hectares (302 acres) in central Dhaka, inaugurated on 2 January 2013, according to Wikipedia. The name means Lake of Elephants. The project surrounds Tejgaon, Gulshan, Badda, Rampura, Banasree, Niketan and Moghbazar and was built partly to ease traffic between Rampura and Tejgaon.
The Dhaka Tribune lists 8.8 km of footpaths, 9.8 km of walkway and 13 viewing decks in the plan. Wikipedia adds that RAJUK took over maintenance from the army in 2021. Cafés now sit on the lakefront.

Tejgaon, an industrial and business district

Development of the Tejgaon Industrial Area began in the 1950s, when the Public Works Department set aside 500 acres, according to a BUET study and a Business Standard report. Dhaka's 1959 master plan backed industry here, and the Dhaka Improvement Trust planned it as a light industrial hub in 1968. Wikipedia says the thana was established in 1947 and had a population of 123,157 in 2022.

The same source describes Tejgaon as an important business district and says the first five-star hotel in Bangladesh, Pan Pacific Hotel Sonargaon, is here. Localities include Karwan Bazar, Nakhalpara, Shaheen Bag, East and West Raja Bazar, Tejturi Bazar, Monipuripara and Tejkunipara.

Bangladesh University of Textiles, Dhaka Polytechnic Institute and Hamdard Public College are among the institutions Wikipedia lists in Tejgaon. Factory and office staff work shifts, and students have class timetables. The 3-day Barista Intermediate course is the easiest to plan around both. Longer courses suit people who want café work as a full-time path.
DSCA's address is Farmgate, and Wikipedia lists Farmgate under Tejgaon Thana. Tejgaon Industrial Area is a separate thana created in 2006, so check which part of Tejgaon you are travelling from.

Roughly 1.5 to 2.5 km, depending on the exact lane and the traffic on the way to the Farmgate junction.
